templates.name: Invest App
templates.summary: Mobile investing app: deal pools, deal and company pages, portfolio with payout schedules, top-up and invest drawers, onboarding chat and an AI assistant that answers with charts, deal cards and actions.
useWhen: Starting a mobile-first fintech or investing product with a portfolio, a catalogue of offers and payouts
An app that needs an AI assistant answering inside the product with charts, cards and confirmable actions
avoidWhen: Desktop dashboards: the layout is a single phone-width column with a bottom tab bar
Products without money flows: most screens assume balances, investments and payouts
stack: Django + Postgres API with LLM and MCP agent in server/
templates.source: A hackathon investor app; brand, logos and data replaced with neutral samples

templates.name: Telegram-style Messenger
templates.summary: Mobile messenger modelled on Telegram's open-source client: chat list with folder tabs, pinned and muted chats, unread badges, chat screen with bubbles, replies, reactions, voice and photo messages, group chat, profile with shared media, and settings.
useWhen: Starting a mobile messenger or in-app chat product
Needing a reference for a chat list, a chat screen with replies and reactions, and a profile page
avoidWhen: An AI assistant chat, where the ai-chat components fit
A desktop inbox or support console: the layout is one phone-width column
templates.source: Layout and behaviour modelled on Telegram's open-source mobile clients; rewritten compactly in React with neutral sample data and no Telegram assets

components.name: Button

avoidWhen: The input needs effort levels, sparks, voice or command menus, where ai-chat/prompt-bar fits

components.name: Chat Screen
components.summary: A full AI chat layout: header, scrolling conversation with auto-scroll, an empty state with starter questions, and the composer pinned at the bottom.
useWhen: A standalone AI chat page or full-height panel is needed
A ready layout joining the conversation and the composer
avoidWhen: An assistant docked beside a dashboard page, where ai-chat/ai-assistant-01 fits

components.name: Context Usage
components.summary: A small ring showing how much of an AI model's context is used, with a hover card of token details.

avoidWhen: People don't choose models or manage context

components.name: Conversation
components.summary: The turns of an AI chat: right-aligned user bubbles, open assistant replies with a mark, copy, feedback and regenerate actions, failed replies with retry and a typing indicator.
useWhen: Showing an AI assistant conversation
Replies need copy, feedback, regenerate or retry actions
avoidWhen: A conversation between people, where the messaging parts fit

components.name: Lattice Loader

avoidWhen: You know the real progress and should show a percentage

components.name: Live Orb
components.summary: A sphere with two capsule eyes that follow the pointer, showing an assistant's idle, listening or thinking state with breathing, a pulse ring or blinking.
useWhen: A voice or assistant panel that needs a visible presence showing whether it is listening or working
A friendly empty state for an AI feature, where the orb's eyes follow the cursor
avoidWhen: Status shown alongside text in a conversation, where ai-chat/trace or ai-chat/lattice-loader is clearer
Dense or small UI where the eyes are too small to read, or where an animated character would distract

components.name: Prompt Bar
components.summary: An AI chat input. The classic bar has a level selector, sparks at the top level, a morphing send button, rotating placeholders, and optional sources, commands, models and dictation. The expanding pill rests as a mic pill and opens into a card with suggestions, a model picker and an effort chip.
useWhen: An AI chat or agent needs its main input
Users choose how much effort or depth the AI should use
A compact voice-first input should grow into a full composer on focus
avoidWhen: A plain search box or short form field is enough
The app needs rich text editing
